scope: Official-source page and catalog checks for the 2026-10-29 proposal slate. This is availability triage, not an experiment, download receipt, source-byte hash, or organizer authentication.

method.tool: Arena page fetch / public official catalog API
method.limitation: A readable official record or returned download URL is not proof that the corresponding binary was downloaded, hashed, licensed for this exact use, or fully covers the template footprint.

verified_facts: USGS 3DEP page states that 3DEP products are available free of charge and without use restrictions.

TNM product queries for the 1-meter DEM GeoTIFF dataset returned public-domain USGS tiles with direct download URLs in small windows intersecting finite cells of the restored sample-template footprint.
sources.payload_status: Catalog availability and two active-footprint spot locations verified; the large GeoTIFF payloads were not downloaded or hashed. Complete footprint coverage, tile seams, and actual source bytes remain unverified.
sources.candidate_gate: not sufficient to declare an experiment-ready hypothesis viable

verified_facts: The GDR record is publicly accessible under CC BY 4.0 and describes well/spring temperature and aqueous-geochemistry datasets.
The record lists wellspringdata.gdb.zip at 19.85 MB.

local_owner_mirror_audit.leakage_warning: dist_known_fault_px is catalogue-derived; it must not be used as a candidate feature or label. Repeated rows/cells are not independent samples.

sources.payload_status: Official listing and license wording verified; exact official geodatabase retrieval failed with HTTP 500 and no official bytes are staged. The owner-mirror CSV is not an authenticated substitute and lacks the raw aqueous-ion fields required by the proposed mixing-front test.

verified_facts: The USGS ScienceBase record describes five conductance maps derived from a 3D Great Basin MT model, spanning 2–200 km depth.
The record lists separate surface, middle-crust, lower-crust, upper-mantle, and mantle conductance GeoTIFF products.
sources.payload_status: Official metadata page and attachment names are readable; layer payloads were not downloaded, hashed, or checked for target-grid coverage, spatial resolution, license terms, or usable edge detail.
sources.candidate_gate: blocked pending payload, grid/resolution, coverage, and license audit

verified_facts: The official USGS record describes the 2024 GeoDAWN magnetic/radiometric survey release and identifies CC0 1.0 rights.
sources.payload_status: The local 19-band training raster matches an owner-mirror SHA-256 pin, not an official USGS file hash; no official GeoDAWN binary was downloaded in this review.
sources.candidate_gate: official source identified; local bytes remain owner-mirror provenance only

verified_facts: GDR lists a public CC BY 4.0 GIS Files.zip (3.79 MB).
The official README says LiDAR fault picks were only field-verified in Dixie Valley and Gabbs Valley.
BRIDGE fault-pick transfer is already proposed as H33-7 and A33-R2-H5 in repository prior art, so it is not included as a new hypothesis here.
sources.payload_status: Official page and README readable, but the GIS archive fetch returned HTTP 500; no archive bytes/schema/CRS/target-overlap evidence are staged.
sources.candidate_gate: blocked; retained as prior-art/source-access check only

verified_facts: The official record describes 3D fault and stratigraphic-surface points in NAD83 UTM Zone 11N and marks the work CC0 1.0.
The generic Gabbs 3D-surface transfer idea is already listed as H33-8; it is not claimed as a new hypothesis here.
sources.payload_status: Official page is accessible; the attached fault-surface payload was not downloaded or geometrically inspected.
sources.candidate_gate: not selected; existing prior art and payload not staged

decision.reason: Official catalogue records and some in-footprint product listings are verified, but no candidate-required official binary payload has been staged with hash, schema, license, and full coverage validation. The 3DEP source passes only a two-point catalog-availability precheck.
decision.method_lane: not identifiable in the current request; no lane inferred
decision.next_gate: Obtain and pin required official payload(s), audit schema/CRS/license/coverage and leakage risks, and obtain an explicit method paragraph before any holdout run.
